1: Outside a rural diner in the dead of night, four men lie on the ground, and the sheriff points to one man as the culprit.
2: And sure enough, the phone rings. The man's name was Jack Reacher.
3: A police car pulls up outside the diner, and the deputies check on the injured men.
4: Reacher sits at the counter in handcuffs. His wallet held only an expired military ID, thirty-eight dollars, and a toothbrush.
5: The deputies laughed at him, but Reacher knew everything they had done on Army land.
6: Reacher slips out of the cuffs, walks out of the diner, and hitchhikes down a road in the rainy night.
7: Reacher took down the deputies who had been kidnapping illegal immigrants and selling them. His help came from the other end of a phone line: Major Susan Turner, the commander of the military police unit.
8: Reacher holds the phone in a motel room, and the voice on the other end welcomes him.
9: The two had stayed connected only by phone for months. Reacher heads to Washington, saying he'll take her to dinner.
10: After switching buses along the way, Reacher arrives in Washington. He walks through the gates of his old unit for the first time in a long while.
11: But when he gets to the MP office, Turner isn't there. She had already been arrested.
12: Colonel Morgan, her replacement, tells him only that Turner has been arrested and says to stop asking questions.
13: A female soldier he passes in the hallway quietly tells him who Turner's lawyer is.
14: Reacher goes to see Turner's lawyer. Instead of talking about Turner, the lawyer hands him some unrelated papers: a paternity suit claiming Reacher has a 15-year-old daughter.
15: At the Fort Dyer military prison, Colonel Moorcroft, who is defending Turner, isn't happy to see Reacher.
16: Reacher demands to see Turner, but the lawyer only tells him to wait until tomorrow.
17: Someone starts following Reacher. He takes down the two men tailing him in no time.
18: Reacher sits by a diner window, looking at a photo of Samantha. Meanwhile, a black SUV watches him.
19: Curious about the girl who might be his daughter, Reacher secretly goes to see Samantha. But Samantha notices that he's been following her.
20: Samantha secretly shoplifts from a store. Reacher watches her do it, and the girl catches him.
21: Samantha pushes Reacher away, saying she doesn't live with her mother.
22: Meeting the lawyer, Colonel Moorcroft, again, Reacher hears that two investigators Turner sent to Afghanistan were murdered. Turner was arrested the next day.
23: Reacher warns the lawyer that a company called Parasource is following him.
24: That night, Parasource's killer, the Hunter, ties the lawyer up, tortures him, and kills him.
25: The next morning. The lawyer is found dead, and MP Captain Espin arrests Reacher for the murder.
26: Reacher is taken to MP headquarters. Colonel Morgan points out the fresh wounds on his hands.
27: Locked up in the military prison, Reacher realizes that the men who came to kill Turner are already inside.
28: Strange men appear on the prison's surveillance screens. Reacher senses that they are after Turner.
29: Reacher asks the lawyer to get him a sandwich, sending her out of the room, and takes a key from her briefcase.
30: Reacher knocks out Captain Espin, who was escorting him, and takes his uniform. Then he heads for Turner's cell.
31: Two thugs are waiting in front of Turner's cell. Reacher takes them down in an instant.
32: After dealing with the thugs who were after Turner, the two of them escape from the prison.
33: The two cross the parking lot and climb into a food truck. The MPs seal off the lot, but it's already too late.
34: At MP headquarters, Colonel Morgan puts out a wanted order for Reacher and Turner as dangerous fugitives.
35: Cutting across a park, the two get into a taxi. Turner blames herself for her men's deaths.
36: In the taxi, Turner says her men were killed not by the Taliban but by friendly fire.
37: The two go to an internet cafe to find her men's final report. But the moment they log in, their location is exposed.
38: The Hunter gets their location from Morgan and heads to the internet cafe.
39: The Hunter chases them all the way into a restaurant kitchen. He clashes with Reacher, but the police burst in and he loses them.
40: Escaping the Hunter's pursuit, the two dash into a restaurant kitchen. Turner picks up a meat mallet.
41: The Hunter tells the police he's military police, and he slips away without a hitch.
42: The two board a bus. That night, Turner confesses that she envied Reacher's drifter life.
43: The Hunter assures Parasource's General Harkness that he will deal with Reacher alone.
44: Reacher brings Turner new clothes and tells her it's time to stop being the fugitive and become the hunter.
45: Believing Morgan gave their location to the Hunter, the two sneak into Colonel Morgan's house. Morgan turns out to be part of the gang they're after.
46: After pulling the report at the library, Turner asks her old subordinate, Sergeant Green, to find out where Prudhomme is.
47: Then a photo comes out of the printer: a surveillance photo of Reacher and Samantha together.
48: Fearing for Samantha, who appears in the surveillance photo, the two race to her house. Her foster parents have already been murdered, and Samantha is hiding.
49: In the stolen car, Samantha snaps at Reacher, calling him a kidnapper.
50: Terrified, Samantha ends up throwing up in the car.
51: Reacher leaves Samantha at the boarding school Turner once attended.
52: On the boarding school grounds, Turner's old teacher warmly welcomes Samantha.
53: Sitting among the rich kids, Samantha smiles awkwardly and takes out her phone.
54: But the text Samantha sent to a friend gets traced, and the three hurriedly leave the school.
55: Back in the car, the three of them listen as Sergeant Green reports that Parasource is strapped for cash.
56: The three buy plane tickets with someone else's credit card that Samantha found, and they barely make it through airport security.
57: On the plane to New Orleans, Samantha says her dad was a soldier.
58: Reacher takes down a mercenary on the same plane. Then the Hunter calls with a threat: hand over Turner and the kid will live.
59: After leaving the airport, the three of them listen as Reacher admits that the men are after Samantha because they think she's his daughter.
60: Crossing the airport tarmac, the three hide on a shuttle bus. The Hunter's men are a step too late.
61: The three get a room at a rundown inn. Samantha asks whether he's going to do a DNA test.
62: Samantha confesses that she was actually the one who pushed her mother to file the paternity suit. She says she needed the money.
63: When an angry Samantha tries to leave the room, Reacher comes back with food.
64: Beside the sleeping Samantha, Reacher and Turner finally have dinner alone together.
65: Turner says she'll go find Prudhomme herself, but Reacher tells her to look after Samantha. Sharp words pass between them.
66: Reacher visits the wife of the missing witness Prudhomme to ask where he is, and he deals with the mercenaries who followed him in a warehouse.
67: While Reacher is tailing Prudhomme's wife, this time the mercenaries drag him off to a warehouse.
68: In front of mercenaries who threaten to torture him, Reacher instead starts negotiating.
69: Reacher gets out of the warehouse. Police car lights are approaching.
70: The next morning, Turner teaches Samantha a self-defense move for taking a gun away from an attacker.
71: MP Captain Espin also arrives in New Orleans and begins questioning the captured mercenaries.
72: Outside the motel bathroom, Reacher and Turner clash again: Reacher is used to working alone, and Turner has lost her men.
73: But Samantha is gone. She had gone out alone early in the morning and found out where Prudhomme is.
74: Reacher sits beside the sleeping Samantha. He looks down at the girl for a long time.
75: An old warehouse pointed out by a veteran in a wheelchair. Reacher and Turner walk past the homeless people.
76: Prudhomme is found in an abandoned warehouse where veterans gather. He confesses that Parasource diverted weapons from Afghanistan and sold them.
77: Afghanistan, in Prudhomme's memory. A Parasource convoy is caught in an ambush by warlords, and the Hunter is there too.
78: With the help of a woman on the street, Reacher slips a phone into Espin's wallet. Soon Espin gets a call.
79: Reacher summons Captain Espin, who had been chasing him, to the docks to meet him as a witness. Then he saves him from Parasource's killers who are after him.
80: Espin shows up at the docks alone. Then snipers start shooting from the darkness.
81: Parasource had lost a billion-dollar government contract and was drowning in debt. Then, suddenly, money started flowing.
82: Meanwhile, Samantha, hungry, orders room service with a stolen card, and Parasource catches the record.
83: With Espin on their side too, the three head to the airport where Parasource's cargo plane has arrived. Turner demands that General Harkness open the weapons crates.
84: But the crates held the weapons, just as declared. Turner is about to be arrested. Then Reacher rips out a rocket launcher.
85: Reacher looks at General Harkness. You couldn't make that kind of money selling weapons.
86: The general, who was bringing in opium instead of weapons, is arrested. But at that moment, the Hunter, who traced the room service record, bursts into the hotel where Samantha is alone.
87: Reacher and Turner race to the hotel in an MP car.
88: Samantha flees into the crowd of a Halloween parade. The Hunter calls Reacher.
89: Turner searches for Samantha in the parade crowd. One of the Hunter's men jumps her from behind, but Turner subdues him with her bare hands.
90: The Hunter chases Samantha across the rooftops. Samantha hides behind an air conditioner unit.
91: Chased all the way onto the roof, Samantha has the Hunter's gun pointed at her head.
92: The moment he pretends to lower the gun, Samantha breaks free with the technique Turner taught her. Reacher jumps down from the roof and fights the Hunter.
93: Reacher takes the Hunter down. Twisting the Hunter's arm, he tells him to look straight at him.
94: Turner and Samantha support Reacher as he comes down the stairs, covered in wounds.
95: Cleared of the charges after the general's arrest, Turner puts her uniform back on and says her final goodbye to Reacher.
96: Turner returns to the MP office and receives salutes from her men.
97: And Reacher meets Samantha again. Samantha tells him he isn't her dad.
98: When Samantha asks if he's leaving, Reacher says yes.
99: Samantha hugs Reacher tightly and walks into the school.
100: That was Jack Reacher: Never Go Back, directed by Edward Zwick. Tom Cruise returned as the drifting investigator.
101: A drifter who risked his life for a child who might be his daughter. Would you hit the road again like Reacher? Let us know in the comments.
